proposed_fixes.title: Dismiss Quick Accent toolbar after its input session ends
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Red hypothesis: a Quick Accent input session can reach a terminal state without running toolbar hide/cleanup, leaving the last candidate visible until another input or module toggle resets it.
plan: Inspect show, selection, timeout, focus-loss, and cancellation transitions to identify which terminal event fails to hide the toolbar.
Route the confirmed terminal transition through the existing hide/cleanup path without dismissing during active selection.
Add focused coverage for the reproduced stuck-toolbar transition and normal selection.
verification: Follow the reporter-confirmed sequence on current build and verify the toolbar disappears when the session ends.
Verify candidate selection, typing another character, cancelling, and toggling Quick Accent still behave normally.

confidence.rationale: Multiple reports support the symptom, but no common trigger or current-version reproduction identifies the missing transition.

issue_context.summary: Several Quick Accent users say its candidate toolbar can remain visible after input is finished; they report different workarounds, but the triggering transition is unknown.
known_information: The issue asks to remove the toolbar when it is no longer needed.
A version 0.77.0 report says the toolbar stuck on the last character and typing another character cleared it.
Other comments report versions 0.79.0 and 0.80.1; one says toggling Quick Accent clears it.
Thread includes older diagnostic ZIPs from 2022 and January 2024.
inferences: Different workarounds are consistent with stale toolbar/session state but do not identify the terminal event that fails to dismiss it.
issue_context.analysis: The repeated symptom suggests a lifecycle/dismissal defect, but the thread lacks a common trigger and current-version confirmation. Ask only for those discriminators rather than generic logs.

Compared reports on 0.77.0, 0.79.0, and 0.80.1 and noted distinct typing and module-toggle workarounds.

comment.body:
Thanks for the reports that the toolbar can remain on the last character, prior support attachments, and workarounds of typing another character or toggling Quick Accent. The latest report only confirms version 0.80.1; the thread does not show which input-ending event leaves the toolbar visible.
Please provide:
1. Whether this still happens on the latest stable version.
2. If so, the shortest numbered sequence from activating Quick Accent until the toolbar remains visible, including whether you selected a candidate, cancelled, changed focus, or stopped typing.
This identifies the lifecycle transition a fix must cover.
